title: Docura - The Open Source Typora Alternative
excerpt: Docura is an Open Source Alternative for Typora for Windows, macOS and Linux. A simple, elegant, and powerful markdown editor that provides a seamless writing experience with real-time preview and extensive customization options.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available on Windows, macOS and Linux via executable files. For Linux, rpm, deb and Arch .xz and source code are available for installation.
features: Real-time preview: See your markdown rendered as you type
Syntax highlighting: Supports syntax highlighting for code blocks in various programming languages
Customizable themes: Choose from a variety of themes or create your own to personalize your writing
Distraction-free mode: Focus on your writing with a clean and minimal interface
Export options: Export your documents to HTML, PDF, and other formats
Cross-platform: Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Open Source: Free to use and modify under the APL-2.0 License
Lightweight: Fast and responsive, even with large documents
File organization: Manage your markdown files with ease using built-in file explorer
Keyboard shortcuts: Boost your productivity with customizable keyboard shortcuts
Tauri and Rust-based: Built using Tauri and Rust for enhanced performance and security
description: Docura is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a powerful yet user-friendly markdown editor. Its open-source nature allows for community contributions and continuous improvement, making it a reliable tool for all your markdown editing needs.

title: Persian Subtitle Fixer
excerpt: A simple tool to fix common issues in Persian subtitles, such as encoding problems, incorrect character mappings, and formatting errors. It helps ensure that Persian subtitles display correctly across different media players and devices.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available as a standalone executable for Windows. Source code can be compiled for other platforms.
features: Encoding correction: Fixes common encoding issues in Persian subtitles
Character mapping: Corrects incorrect character mappings specific to Persian script
Formatting adjustments: Cleans up formatting errors to improve subtitle readability
Batch processing: Allows users to fix multiple subtitle files at once
User-friendly interface: Simple and intuitive UI for easy use
Open Source: Free to use and modify under the MIT License
Lightweight: Minimal resource usage for quick processing
Qt-based: Built using the Qt framework for cross-platform compatibility
Drag-and-drop support: Easily add subtitle files by dragging them into the application window
Preview feature: View changes before saving the fixed subtitles
description: Persian Subtitle Fixer is a valuable tool for anyone working with Persian subtitles, ensuring that they are displayed correctly and enhancing the viewing experience for Persian-speaking audiences.

title: Network Manager TUI (nmtui)
excerpt: Network Manager TUI (nmtui) is a text-based user interface for managing network connections on Linux systems. It provides a simple and efficient way to configure and monitor network settings without the need for a graphical interface.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available for Linux systems via package managers or source code compilation.
features: Text-based interface: Operates in the terminal, making it suitable for headless systems
Network configuration: Allows users to create, edit, and delete network connections
Wi-Fi management: Supports connecting to and managing Wi-Fi networks
IWD support: Compatible with the IWD (iNet Wireless Daemon) for wireless network management
802.1X support: Supports enterprise Wi-Fi networks with 802.1X authentication
description: Network Manager TUI (nmtui) is an essential tool for Linux users who need to manage network connections in a terminal environment. Its text-based interface and robust features make it a reliable choice for configuring and monitoring network settings on various Linux distributions.

title: Ananicy in Rust
excerpt: Ananicy in Rust is a reimplementation of ananicy using the Rust programming language, aiming to provide better performance, safety, and maintainability. It automatically adjusts the CPU and nice levels of processes based on predefined profiles.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available for Linux systems via source code compilation and AUR package for Arch Linux.
features: Automatic CPU and nice level adjustment: Dynamically adjusts process priorities based on predefined profiles
Rust-based: Built using the Rust programming language for improved performance and safety
Profile management: Allows users to create and manage profiles for different types of processes
Lightweight: Minimal resource usage for efficient operation
Open Source: Free to use and modify under the APL-2.0 License
Support all configurations from ananicy and ananicy-cpp
Easy to use: Simple configuration and setup process
Cgroup v2 support: Compatible with cgroup v2 for resource management
Systemd integration: Works seamlessly with systemd for process management
Community-driven: Open to contributions and improvements from the community
description: Ananicy in Rust is a valuable tool for Linux users looking to optimize process management and system performance. Its Rust implementation ensures reliability and efficiency, making it a great choice for managing CPU and nice levels of processes on Linux systems.

title: XCopy in Rust and libadwaita with GTK4
excerpt: XCopy is a simple and efficient file copying tool built using Rust and libadwaita with GTK4. It provides a user-friendly interface for copying files and directories, with features such as progress tracking, error handling, and customizable options.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available for Linux systems via source code compilation. AppImage and AUR package for Arch Linux.
features: User-friendly interface: Built using libadwaita and GTK4 for a modern and intuitive experience
Progress tracking: Displays progress bars and estimated time remaining during file copying
Error handling: Provides informative error messages and options for handling copy errors
Customizable options: Allows users to configure copy settings, such as buffer size and overwrite behavior
Rust-based: Built using the Rust programming language for improved performance and safety
Lightweight: Minimal resource usage for efficient operation
Open Source: Free to use and modify under the APL-2.0 License
Drag-and-drop support: Easily add files and directories to copy by dragging them into the application window
Batch copying: Supports copying multiple files and directories simultaneously
Community-driven: Open to contributions and improvements from the community
description: XCopy is an excellent choice for Linux users seeking a reliable and efficient file copying tool. Its Rust implementation and modern interface make it a standout option for managing file transfers on Linux systems.

title: Ventoy Image Writer in PySide6
excerpt: Ventoy Image Writer is a graphical tool built using PySide6 for writing ISO and IMG files to USB drives. It provides a simple and intuitive interface for creating bootable USB drives, making it easy for users to install operating systems or run live environments.
author: Ehsan Tork
install: Available for Windows and Linux systems via executable files. Source code can be compiled for other platforms.
features: User-friendly interface: Built using PySide6 for a modern and intuitive GUI
Multi-format support: Supports writing ISO, IMG, and other image formats to USB drives
Progress tracking: Displays progress bars and estimated time remaining during the writing process
Verification: Option to verify the integrity of the written image after completion
Cross-platform: Available for both Windows and Linux systems
Open Source: Free to use and modify under the APL-2.0 License
Lightweight: Minimal resource usage for efficient operation
Drag-and-drop support: Easily add image files by dragging them into the application window
Batch writing: Supports writing multiple images to different USB drives simultaneously
Community-driven: Open to contributions and improvements from the community
description: Ventoy Image Writer is a valuable tool for users looking to create bootable USB drives with ease. Its PySide6-based interface and robust features make it a reliable choice for writing image files to USB drives on both Windows and Linux systems.
